proof_summary: For primes \(p,q\) with different last digits and \(pq\le150\), if neither divides \(d\), invertibility of \(d\bmod pq\) makes one of the first \(150\) terms divisible by both \(p\) and \(q\), contradicting the required prime-factor pattern. Applying this obstruction to selected pairs among \(2,3,5,7,11,13,17\) forces \(2\cdot3\cdot5\cdot7\mid d\) and either \(11\mid d\) or \(13\mid d\), hence \(d\ge2310>2025\).
